description: GeoThermalCloud.jl publishes Julia machine-learning workflows, site data, notebooks and intermediate results for geothermal exploration. It demonstrates analyses for the Brady field in Nevada, Southwest New Mexico and the Great Basin. Inputs include geothermal site observations and geologic attributes; outputs are learned patterns, prospect maps and diagnostic figures. Site and regional coverage follows those three U.S. demonstrations, with spatial resolution set by the supplied data. Source is free under GPL-3.0 and the README documents package and notebook entry points. The methods rely on separate SmartTensors components such as NMFk and NTFk. A limitation is that the repository is a collection of site workflows, not a general calibrated reservoir-flow simulator; applying it to another field requires compatible data and checking the learned signatures. It supports geothermal resource screening for energy infrastructure. It is related to FALCON-style reservoir modelling but addresses exploration, not coupled physical dynamics. No site data or notebooks were downloaded.
